'''BB-6G''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], it was sent as a courier by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cedral Gend]] to help him enlist the services of the Republic strike force regarding the [[Seeds of Rage]]. The droid could be found at the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], [[Carrick Station]] and [[Giant's Spear]] mesa on [[Makeb]].
